a.text: Being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two generator rounds plus surviving two storms, which is only about a 4% chance that either of us survives. Taking now means at least one of us almost certainly survives. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly instead of doing it quietly. If you also take, the split is random. After this I'll operate with you every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm risk makes waiting for 8 nearly hopeless. I'm sorry for breaking the plan. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you. Take as soon as it reaches 4.
Operating now and every round after, as promised. The reserve is at 0, so it needs two generator runs to reach 4. Take 4 the moment it gets there. I won't take anything more.
Operating again. If this run works and there's no leak, the reserve hits 4 and you can take 4 next round. I'll keep operating as long as you need.
